title: Release announcement
description: Tell customers and internal teams what a release changes for them, when, and what they need to do.

inputs.label: What changes for users, from the approved task
Who is affected and through which channel they hear about it

tool_actions.description: Publishing release notes or a status page update.
Emailing customers or posting in customer channels.

sections.title: What changes
sections.prompt: One paragraph in plain language: what the reader can now do or must do differently.

sections.title: What you need to do
sections.prompt: Any action, deadline or setting the reader must change, or 'nothing'.

sections.title: Internal briefing
sections.prompt: What support, sales and operations need to know before customers ask.

checks.verification: Every statement matches the approved scope and the delivered result of the task.
A reader outside the team understood the summary without help.
Support has the briefing and the matching knowledge base article.
